text:
maria-support: Heads-up — Customer AcmeEditor reported a spike in streaming failures this morning. They see 'broken pipe' during long-running saves and are getting billed because those are counted as 5xx. They provided traces and a short repro.

maria-support: logs attached from our gateway: ```2026-03-17T09:12:03Z gateway error: upstream read: broken pipe; upstream_addr=10.5.3.22:8080 client_addr=34.12.56.78 req_id=0f3b9a````

jon-eng: Can you paste the trace id and the exact client behavior? Is the client sending chunked bodies with long pauses?

maria-support: Trace 0f3b9a above. Customer says VSCode extension sends a stream with ~25s pauses between chunks, then sometimes closes the socket when user cancels. They see gateway incrementing 502/5xx counters when client aborts.

kai-sre: That matches a classifier issue — we currently classify early upstream EOF as gateway 5xx. If the TCP FIN/RST originates from the client, we should mark it client_abort and not attribute as our 5xx.

jon-eng: Repro plan: run a minimal client that writes chunked frames with sleeps and then closes. If gateway increments 5xx instead of client_abort, we confirm. Local repro snippet we used: ```python
# pseudo
s=socket.socket(); s.connect(...)
s.send(b"4\r\nTest\r\n")
time.sleep(28)
s.send(b"0\r\n\r\n")
# sometimes client closes before trailers
```

maria-support: Customer provided Node repro too: ```node
const http = require('http');
const req = http.request(opts);
req.write('4\r\nabcd\r\n');
setTimeout(() => req.destroy(), 25000); // simulate user cancel
```

jon-eng: Good. I can reproduce with curl and with Node. Observed: upstream returns EOF while our gateway still expecting body, we bubble as 502. Need to detect client-side FIN vs upstream error.

kai-sre: Short-term mitigation: add a non-billing metric label 'client_disconnected_midstream' and exclude that from billing counts. Ops can toggle if approved. Long-term: update EOF classifier to check socket peer state (RST/FIN) and X-Forwarded-Proto timing to attribute correctly.

maria-support: Customer is asking for ETA — can we give a timeline? They want assurance they won't be billed for user cancels. :thinking:

jon-eng: ETA for metric label + ops flag: few hours. ETA for classifier change + canary: 2-3 days. Will create PR for metric + small patch to classifier to avoid false 5xx on client-initiated half-close.

kai-sre: I'll open an incident-style ticket and include repro steps and logs, then coordinate canary with eng-infra. @deploy-bot start a canary when patch ready.

maria-support: Tina from billing looped in: @tina-fin please hold any automatic invoice adjustments until we confirm counts.

 t ina-fin: (note: tina-fin) Acknowledged. Need expected delta and list of affected customers before any refunds.

jon-eng: Will post numbers once we have metric labeled data from a 24h window after the patch. For now, customer-facing message: we can prevent charges from client-initiated cancels and are prioritizing a fix; will update within the day with short-term mitigation. :thumbsup:

maria-support: I'll send the customer a concise summary and ask for any additional logs. Thanks all.
